Outpaint (opt-in, last resort)

Data sent to a cloud provider: layout JSON (layer tags, rects, text strings, target size) + one 256 px low-res thumbnail. Never source files, never full-res footage.
Local: ONNX saliency (in-app) + LLM via Ollama / LM Studio (http://127.0.0.1:11434 / :1234), RTX 3070 Ti 8 GB — 7–8B Q4 models ASSUMED to fit. Cost: 0.
Cloud: Claude (Anthropic API key), Grok (xAI API key), GPT (OpenAI API key). Billed per token by the provider on your key; ~1–3k tokens per size per call (ASSUMED). Account sign-in instead of keys only where the vendor offers it (ASSUMED/limited).

Jev AI (cloud only, decide/score tasks): POST https://thejevai.com/v1/systemone · model jev-latest · typed questions Choice (template, auto-tag, chunk split) / Score (quality) / Noul (needs-review) · text/JSON layout state only, no images · key stays server-side (proxy env JEV_API_KEY), never in the browser. API shape ASSUMED from brief.
